# NaufalRF Links Hub — Full LLM Context

## Overview

This Astro app is the dedicated links/profile hub for the portfolio ecosystem. It is intentionally narrower than the main public portfolio site: one page, fast loading, profile-first presentation, and a clean split between social icons and destination buttons.

## Core responsibilities

- Render a compact but expressive profile header.
- Show true social/profile destinations as icon links.
- Show website/general destinations as larger action buttons.
- Keep the page resilient when Admin data is slow or temporarily unavailable.
- Track pageviews and clicks via same-origin analytics proxy routes.

## Architecture

- Framework: Astro 5 with React support available but minimal island usage.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS-first theme tokens and a light-neumorphic visual shell.
- Data source: Admin public APIs through `src/lib/api.ts`.
- Telemetry: same-origin `src/pages/api/analytics.ts` proxy.

## Key files

- `src/pages/index.astro` — page composition and data loading.
- `src/lib/api.ts` — fetches about/profile-links data from Admin public APIs.
- `src/lib/link-classification.ts` — normalized URL-aware classification for social vs website links.
- `src/components/ProfileHeader.astro` — profile/avatar/name/bio block.
- `src/components/SocialIcons.astro` — social icon rendering with supported platform detection.
- `src/components/LinkButtons.astro` — non-social destination buttons.

## Constraints

- Never bypass Admin for links/about data.
- Do not collapse social icons and website buttons into one undifferentiated list.
- Preserve the fast-loading single-page nature of the app.
- Keep the page visually consistent with the broader portfolio ecosystem while remaining denser and more profile-card-like.
